title: Project-context-aware routing
root_cause: Project-map revision is receipted but its typed facts do not influence ranking or capability package construction.
source_requirement: Feed bounded typed project features into routing scores and receipts, or explicitly constrain the project map to evidence-only use.
implementation_steps: Bind feature revision into the task plan.
Expose each influence in the package receipt.
negative_cases: Two materially different project maps yield identical relevant routing.
affected_tests: Task plan, capability routing, and project intelligence tests.
evidence_required: Paired-map discriminating receipt with transparent score components.
rollback: Disable project features and retain revision-only evidence behavior explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant typed project facts affect scoring/package construction deterministically.
Every influence is project-scoped and receipted.
